title: [P1][inventory,touch-target] Consume-action buttons under the 44px touch target
goal: 'Used it up', 'Used some', 'Wasted', and the 25/50/75% fraction buttons in consume-actions.tsx:63-79 all use size='sm' (h-8, 32px) -- the highest-frequency, ledger-writing taps in the whole app, sitting below the 44px target already used elsewhere in the same design system (checkbox and icon-button sizes are already size-11/44px).
in_scope: Increase the touch target of the consume-action buttons in consume-actions.tsx (item detail page) to at least 44x44px -- e.g. size='md' or 'lg'.
Verify the larger buttons don't crowd the item-detail layout, particularly on narrow mobile widths where this control is most used.
out_of_scope: Touch-target sizing on review-detail.tsx's controls -- covered separately by S-91.
Any change to the confirm-step behavior of these buttons -- covered separately by S-94.
acceptance: The consume-action buttons (Used it up, Used some, Wasted, and the fraction shortcuts) have a touch target of at least 44x44px, consistent with the 44px sizing already used elsewhere in this design system, without crowding the item-detail layout at mobile widths.
invariants: The larger touch target must not visually dominate the item-detail page relative to other controls -- verify against the page's existing visual hierarchy.
